design.partition: stable created_at, memory_id, version order; fixed leaf size
design.edge_certificates: SHA-256 over summary content, exact parent versions, fact dependency map, and child certificate edges
design.root_lineage: direct links to leaf summaries and original source versions

oracle_cases: 10 source memories at leaf_size=4 produce stable 4/4/2 grouping and identical root content on repeat
root and every leaf certificate verify against fact maps and exact versioned parents
revising one source version contests only its leaf and root; sibling leaf summaries remain active
stale root certificate verification is refused after parent revision
histories too short for at least two leaves are refused rather than labelled hierarchical

lint.command: python -m ruff check src/memory_fabric/compaction.py src/memory_fabric/summary_dependencies.py src/memory_fabric/_fabric/writes.py tests/test_hierarchical_compaction.py tests/test_summary_dependencies.py tests/test_lossless_compaction.py

limitations: The implementation is a deterministic two-level hierarchy; deeper recursive trees are not qualified.
SHA-256 certificates detect mismatched content/edges but are not signatures or proof against an authorized writer changing both data and digest.
Hierarchy was tested on synthetic local histories, not distributed stores or external model summaries.
